description: Manage the state of a program monitored using Monit.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the monit program/process to manage.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: If there are pending actions for the service monitored by monit, then it checks for up to this many seconds to verify the requested action has been performed. The module sleeps for five seconds between each check. Default: 300

examples:
- name: Manage the state of program httpd to be in started state
  community.general.monit:
    name: httpd
    state: started
